text.KJV 1CH 15:8: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

A.name: Joel
A.line: chief of the sons of Gershom (1CH 15:7), son of Ladan (1CH 23:8)
A.notes: Gershonites (Gershomites), from Gershon, son of Levi
family: brother-of jehiel-9 (Jehiel, Gershonite, son of Laadan, whose house (Jehieli) kept the te)

B.name: Joel
B.line: Chief of the Gershonite Levites who brought up the ark under David

why: The Hebrew names one Joel as chief of the sons of Gershom, matching A’s stated office and ancestry. B has the same identifying facts, however, so the supplied verses do not establish A over B; this choice is tentative.
